item.title: Qwen-Image-2.1 Is Out: 7B Does It All — Generation, Editing, Transparency — But the License Changed
item.description: On Sept 20, Qwen open-sourced Qwen-Image-2.1: a 7B model that unifies text-to-image, multi-reference editing, and native RGBA transparency in one checkpoint, with up to 10 reference images. On HN the architecture barely got discussed — the license and the 33.1 GB download did.
